user.title: Connect to Norsup Smartpool
user.description: Most owners sign in with the same email and password as smartpoolconnect.eu. Use API key only if Norsup issued a bearer token.

api_key.title: SPC API key
api_key.description: Paste the API key from the Smart Pool Connect portal (starts with spc_). Pool ID is optional — leave empty to auto-discover.

data_description.api_key: SPC REST API key (spc_…), not your portal password or pool UUID.
data_description.pool_id: Only needed if you have multiple pools; otherwise discovered from the API key.

portal.title: Smart Pool Connect account
portal.description: Same login as the website or mobile app. Leave Pool ID empty to auto-discover pools on your account.

choose_pool.title: Choose pool
choose_pool.description: Your account has multiple pools. Select one for this Home Assistant entry.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Smart Pool Connect. Check your network and base URL.
error.invalid_auth: Login or API key rejected. For portal login use your smartpoolconnect.eu email and password.
error.invalid_pool_id: Pool ID must be a UUID (xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx). Copy it from the portal URL.
error.no_pools: Logged in but no pools were found. Claim your pool in the portal first.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check Home Assistant logs for details.

init.title: Update Norsup Smartpool options
init.description: Update your portal password or API key and change the poll interval.

data.enable_diagnostics: Enable diagnostics sensor (reload integration after change)

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Smart Pool Connect. Check your network.
error.invalid_auth: Credentials rejected. The previous secret was kept.
error.invalid_pool_id: Pool ID must be a UUID. Reconfigure the integration if the stored pool ID is invalid.
